g.text: Shelter Map - Shelter API (read + write + community reviews)
addReview(user : RegisteredUser, shelterId : Long, rating : int, comment : String) : SaveResult
updateReview(user : RegisteredUser, shelterId : Long, rating : int, comment : String) : ShelterReview
GET /api/shelters/mine (Bearer JWT - the CALLER's shelters, NOT public)
Author check (PUT/DELETE): 404 if absent, 403 if not the author - registry rows and
legacy created_by-NULL rows are unmanageable by anyone (ids are public, so
403-vs-404 leaks nothing). PUT re-checks the Estonia bbox - one shared gate with
Deferred: nearest/bbox queries need GeoService + PostGIS GIST index.
Paging deferred: Estonia-scale data is small; add limit/offset when it grows.
shelters.created_by (V7): BIGINT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL +
idx_shelters_created_by. addPlace sets it (the submitting user); NULL for registry
rows and pre-V7 legacy USER rows. GET /mine queries it; PUT/DELETE gate on it.
Community rating IS the moderation - no moderator role.
- One review per user per shelter (unique shelterId+userId); re-rating updates
- Requires an authenticated, VERIFIED account (any VerificationClaim)
- Aggregates computed per request in v1; denormalize onto Shelter or
